title: Six of Crows
author: Leigh Bardugo
summary: In a crowded trading city, a young criminal mastermind gathers a crew of six outcasts to attempt a break-in at an impregnable fortress, for a vast payment. Each of them has something to prove or to lose.
readIf: you want a heist story with a clever plan, a lot of banter and characters you care about.
skipIf: you want a lot of backstory and explanation, as the plot rushes and assumes you are along for it.

pairings.reason: A more adult, profane fantasy about thieves and long cons, with a similar loyalty among friends.
Another fantasy built around a crew plotting a big heist against a powerful regime.
Another scheming young-adult fantasy with morally murky leads and ruthless plots.
